summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong coverage of core artifact-cleanup logic, configuration parsing, CLI argument handling, and output formatting. Fixtures are well-designed with explicit expected outputs. Good edge-case coverage including boundary conditions (exactly at threshold), empty inputs, invalid values, and policy combinations. Clever act.test.ts design runs the pipeline once and parses exact SUMMARY lines. Gaps: missing explicit environment variable precedence tests (--now flag vs CLEANUP_NOW vs config.now), no tests for inline --flag=value argument format, hardcoded fixture names instead of discovery, no fixture file content validation, missing very-large-number edge cases. act.test.ts batches all execution in beforeAll limiting per-fixture isolation, though this is a reasonable trade-off given act's slowness. Would reliably catch regressions in core deletion logic, output formatting, and configuration parsing, but some subtle edge cases around environment variables and argument parsing could slip through.
